items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to hang out with one of them, Nathan Conyers.

ctx.x: I think a couple years back I remember you getting an award -- by the way did you know John Conyers at that time? Was he on the scene?
I didn’t know Conyers, but the Conyers family had about three or four brothers. I used to hang out with one of them, Nathan Conyers.
That’s the one that owns the car dealership, that’s where you guys -­
